info.description:
# API Henrri Quickstart

Simplified guide for integrating Henrri invoicing services.

## 1. Authentification
`TTL: 600s` Refresh your token every 10 minutes.

> **POST** https://api-sandbox.henrri.io/v1/users/authenticate
```bash
curl -X POST https://api-sandbox.henrri.io/v1/users/authenticate \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "clientId": "YOUR_ID",
    "clientSecret": "YOUR_SECRET"
  }'
```
Success Response:

```bash
{
    "access_token": "eyJhbGci...",
    "expires_in": 600,
    "token_type": "Bearer",
    "refresh_token": "C5B217...",
    "scope": "Document_Read ..."
}
```

## 2. Connectivity Test (Hello World)
Use this endpoint to verify your credentials and token.

> **GET** https://api-sandbox.henrri.io/v1/secures/hello-world
```bash
curl -X GET https://api-sandbox.henrri.io/v1/secures/hello-world \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN"
```

Expected Response:

```bash
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Test de connectivité réussi",
  "data": "Hello World"
}
```

## 3. Retrieve your User and Company information
Use this endpoint to get user and company information.

> **GET** https://api-sandbox.henrri.io/v1/users/me
```bash
curl -X GET https://api-sandbox.henrri.io/v1/users/me \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN"
```

Success Response:

```bash
{
    "user": {
        "id": 11740,
        "email": "...",
        "firstName": "...",
        "lastName": "...",
        "urlImage": "...",
        ...
        "address": {
            "id": 10610,
            "address": "...",
            "city": "...",
            "postCode": "...",
            "country": "",
        }
    },
    "company": {
        "id": 1,
        "name": "...",
        "logoUrl": "...",
        ...
        "address": {
            "id": 2014,
            "address": "...",
            "city": "...",
            "postCode": "...",
            "country": "",
.        }
    }
}
```

get.summary: Get all the customers
get.description:
Get all customers with pagination, sorting and searching capabilities.

**Pagination:**
- `page`:page index requested. Starts at 1.
- `limit`:number of elements per pages query parameters. Default is 50, maximum is 100.

**Searching:**
- `search` : Search string to look for in customers

**Filtering:**
- `fromDate`/ `toDate`: Date range filtering on customers `creationDate`

**Sorting:**
- `sortBy`: Field to sort by
  - id:customer `id`
  - name:customer `name`
  - date:customer `creationDate`
- `sortOrder`: ascending or descending (default: desc)

**Response:**
- `elements` : list of customers for the current page
- `meta.page`:current page index (one-based)
- `meta.limit`:number of items per pages
- `meta.totalCount`:total number of items
- `meta.totalPages`:total number of pages
- `meta.hasNext`:indicates if a next page is available

Returns a paginated list of customers with their contacts.

🔒 **Requires Authorization (bearer token)**

🛡️ **Policies (Scopes) :** `Customer_Read`

Create a new customer. The `contacts` field is required for all customer types.

**Validation rules:**
- The name, type and contacts fields are required
- Type must be 'professional' or 'individual'
- Professional customers must have between 1 and 4 contacts
- Individual customers must have exactly 1 contact
- Individual customers cannot have a SIRET/BCE number or corporate name extension
- Contact last name is required, email must be valid if provided
- If no primary contact is specified, the first contact will be marked as primary

**Company identifier (SIRET / BCE):**
- Use `companyIdentifierType` to specify the identifier format: `siret` or `bce`. Defaults to `siret` if omitted
- SIRET (France): must be exactly 14 digits
- BCE (Belgium): must be 10 digits starting with 0 or 1, with or without dots (e.g. 0123.456.789)

🔒 **Requires Authorization (bearer token)**

post.summary: Create a document line on an existing document
post.description:
Create a document line.
Required fields:
- `typeId` : type of line ; can be recovered with GET on /documentlinetypes

Two line creation scenario are possible.

### Billable item line

If you wish to create a line representing a billable item, you must provide:
- `typeId`
- `itemId` or an `item` object:referencing a billable item

### Text line

If you wish to add a text line, you must provide:
- `typeId`
- `description` : the text

### Layout line

If you wish to add a layout line (horizontalTrait, lineBreak, total, subTotal), you must provide:
- `typeId`

---

Creation is subject to business validation rules.
If an error occured, a detailed **BusinessError** object with a user-friendly message is returned. Business errors can be found in section Business Errors > Document line manipulation.

When DoesGroupOwnDifferentVat is set to true, it signifies that the line item has a distinct VAT rate, which may require special handling during tax calculations and document processing to ensure accurate tax reporting and compliance with tax regulations.

isMemberOfAGroup.description: Whether the line is a member of a group, indicating that it belongs to a specific group of lines within the document. This property is used to identify lines that are part of a group, allowing for the organization and grouping of related line items together. When IsMemberOfAGroup is set to true, it indicates that the line item is associated with a group, and the GroupId property can be used to specify which group it belongs to. This association can be useful for calculating totals, applying discounts, or displaying related line items together in the document.

isAdjustmentOfGroup.description: Whether the line is an adjustment of a group, meaning it is used to adjust the total of a group of lines. This property indicates that the line serves as a correction or modification to the overall total of a group, allowing for adjustments to be made without altering the individual line items within the group. An adjustment line can be used to apply discounts, surcharges, or other modifications to the total amount of a group of lines while keeping the original line items intact.

typeId.description:

This property allows for the categorization and differentiation of line items based on their type, enabling customized processing and display logic in the document.

type.description:
Type of the document line, which can represent billable item, text or help with document layout.
This property helps to determine how the line item should be processed and displayed in the document. For example, an item line may require fetching additional details from the catalog, while a text line may simply display the provided description without any associated item information.

groupId.description:
Unique identifier of the group to which the line item belongs, if applicable. 
This property is used to associate the line item with a specific group within the document, allowing for the organization and grouping of related line items together. 
The presence of a GroupId indicates that the line item is part of a group, while its absence may indicate that the line item is standalone or not associated with any group. 
This association can be useful for calculating totals, applying discounts, or displaying related line items together in the document.

**Required** for billable item line (unless an inline `item` is provided for POST).
**Optional** for text lines.
Unique identifier of the item associated with the line item.
This property is used to link the line item to a specific item in the catalog, allowing for the retrieval of relevant information such as pricing, description, and VAT details when processing or displaying the document line.
The presence of an itemId indicates that the line item is based on an item, while its absence may indicate that the line item is a custom text or adjustment without a direct item association.

tags.description:
### 📖 Business Errors Reference
This section lists all the functional error codes that the API can return, depending on the element and the action.

---

<details style='margin-bottom: 10px;'>
  <summary style='cursor: pointer; font-weight: bold; font-size: 1.1em;'> Document edition (1 errors)</summary>

| Code | Title | Detail |
| :-: | :- | :- |
| `DOCUMENT_FINALIZED` | Document is finalized | You cannot edit a finalized document. |

</details>
<details style='margin-bottom: 10px;'>
  <summary style='cursor: pointer; font-weight: bold; font-size: 1.1em;'> Document deletion (8 errors)</summary>

| Code | Title | Detail |
| :-: | :- | :- |
| `ACCOUNTING_DOCUMENT` | Accounting document | Finalized accounting documents (Invoices, Credit Notes) cannot be deleted to comply with anti-fraud regulations. |
| `AMENDMENT_INTEGRATED` | Amendment already integrated | This amendment is already integrated into a progress invoice. You must remove it from the progress invoice first. |
| `DEPOSIT_EXISTS` | Deposit requested or paid | A deposit has been requested or already paid for this document, preventing its deletion. |
| `DOCUMENT_ALREADY_BILLED` | Document already billed | This document has already been transformed into an invoice and cannot be deleted. |
| `DOCUMENT_IN_USE` | Document currently in use | The document is currently being used by another process or user and cannot be deleted at this time. |
| `DOCUMENT_NOT_FOUND` | Document not found | The document does not exist or was already deleted. |
| `PAYMENT_PENDING` | Pending payment detected | The document cannot be deleted while a payment is being processed or is pending. |
| `QUOTATION_HAS_PROGRESS` | Progress invoice linked | This quotation cannot be deleted because a progress invoice is linked to it. You must delete all non-finalized progress invoices before deleting this quotation. |

</details>
<details style='margin-bottom: 10px;'>
  <summary style='cursor: pointer; font-weight: bold; font-size: 1.1em;'> Document finalization (11 errors)</summary>

| Code | Title | Detail |
| :-: | :- | :- |
| `ALREADY_FINALIZED` | Document already finalized | The document already has a definitive number. It is locked and cannot be edited nor finalized anymore. |
| `CLIENT_MISSING` | Client missing | The document must be associated with a valid customer before it can be finalized. |
| `COMPANY_MISSING` | Company missing | The document is not correctly associated with your company. If you cannot resolve this error by yourself please contact support. |
| `DOCUMENT_NOT_FOUND` | Document not found | The specified document could not be found in the system while finalizing. It might have been deleted while attemtping to finalize it. |
| `DUPLICATE_DOCUMENT` | Duplicate document reference | More than one document exists with the same date, manual number, or prefix. If you cannot resolve this error by yourself please contact support. |
| `LINES_MISSING` | No document lines | The document must contain at least one line to be finalized. |
| `NUMBERING_DATE_SEQUENCE` | Invalid date sequence | A document with a later number already exists with a later date. You must adjust this document's date to maintain chronology. If you cannot resolve this error by yourself please contact support. |
| `NUMBERING_ERROR` | Numbering system error | The automatic numbering system failed to generate a definitive number for this document. If you cannot resolve this error by yourself please contact support. |
| `NUMBERING_MANUAL_NUMBER` | Invalid manual number | The requested manual number does not follow the sequence of the last finalized document. If you cannot resolve this error by yourself please contact support. |
| `NUMBERING_MISMATCH` | Sequential numbering mismatch | The last document by number does not match the last document by date. Check for numbering gaps or date inconsistencies. If you cannot resolve this error by yourself please contact support. |
| `VALIDATION_FAILED` | Data validation failed | Some document data is inconsistent or invalid according to business rules. Please review your lines data before reattempting to finalize. |

</details>
<details style='margin-bottom: 10px;'>
  <summary style='cursor: pointer; font-weight: bold; font-size: 1.1em;'> Document finalization alert (1 errors)</summary>

| Code | Title | Detail |
| :-: | :- | :- |
| `FIRST_ACCOUNTING_DOCUMENT_MONTH` | First accounting document of the month | This will be the first finalized document for the current month. To confirm this action, please set the 'confirmFirstOfMonth' flag to true in your request. |

</details>
<details style='margin-bottom: 10px;'>
  <summary style='cursor: pointer; font-weight: bold; font-size: 1.1em;'> Document line manipulation (8 errors)</summary>

| Code | Title | Detail |
| :-: | :- | :- |
| `DOCUMENT_FINALIZED` | Document is finalized | You cannot operate on lines from a finalized document. Accounting documents are locked for compliance. |
| `DOCUMENT_NOT_FOUND` | Document not found | The document associated with this line could not be found. |
| `ITEM_ERROR` | Linked item creation error | The item you are trying to create does not contain the required fields. Please check the documentation for required fields on Items. |
| `ITEM_NOT_FOND` | Item not found | The item you are trying to link with the line does not exists. |
| `ITEM_REQUIRED` | Item is required on line | The item relation to the line seem missing. Check that the itemId is present in your action and you are trying to assign a correct id. |
| `LINE_NOT_FOUND` | Document line not found | The specific line you are trying to operate on does not exist or has been removed. |
| `NESTED_GROUP` | Nested group lines not allowed | The current action seems to result in nested groups of lines (a group within a group) which is not allowed. |
| `TEXT_ITEM_ERROR` | Linked text item creation error | The text item you are trying to create already exists. Please check the documentation for required fields on Items. |

</details>
<details style='margin-bottom: 10px;'>
  <summary style='cursor: pointer; font-weight: bold; font-size: 1.1em;'> Customer retrieval and manipulation (1 errors)</summary>

| Code | Title | Detail |
| :-: | :- | :- |
| `CUSTOMER_COPY` | Customer record is a copy | The customer record you are trying to recover is a copy and cannot be modified. This copy is used on documents to prevent furter modification in the database. Please try recovering the top level entity instead. |

</details>
<details style='margin-bottom: 10px;'>
  <summary style='cursor: pointer; font-weight: bold; font-size: 1.1em;'> Contact manipulation (1 errors)</summary>

| Code | Title | Detail |
| :-: | :- | :- |
| `PUT_WITH_CUSTOMER` | Contact present in customer PUT | You cannot add, edit or delete contact when making a PUT request on customer. You may manipulate contacts individually through their respective endpoints. |

</details>
<details style='margin-bottom: 10px;'>
  <summary style='cursor: pointer; font-weight: bold; font-size: 1.1em;'> Document transformation (5 errors)</summary>

| Code | Title | Detail |
| :-: | :- | :- |
| `INVALID_SOURCE_TYPE` | Invalid source document type | Only a quotation document can be transformed into an invoice through this endpoint. |
| `INVOICE_TYPE_NOT_FOUND` | Invoice document type missing | No invoice document type is configured for the current company. Please contact support. |
| `QUOTE_ALREADY_DELIVERED` | Quotation already turned into a delivery note | This quotation has already been transformed into a delivery note. Transform the delivery note into an invoice instead. |
| `QUOTE_ALREADY_INVOICED` | Quotation already invoiced | This quotation has already been transformed into an invoice. A quotation cannot be invoiced more than once. |
| `QUOTE_NOT_FINALIZED` | Quotation is not finalized | The source quotation must be finalized before it can be transformed into an invoice. Call the finalize endpoint first. |

</details>
